# Field blocks for Poland

Poland (blocks) field boundaries (2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Agencja Restrukturyzacji i Modernizacji Rolnictwa. License: other.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl_block/latest/pl_block.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl_block/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:2180; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: metrics:area, id, geometry, admin:subdivision_code, parcel_id, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl_block/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl_block/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/pl_block/collection.json
